si_disclosure: OpenAI Codex assisted implementation and documentation. Original NASA source values and carried-forward satellite evidence retain their provenance.

method.fit: OLS on calendar-weighted annual data. Bartlett HAC with finite-sample correction and Student t reference.
method.multiple_testing: Holm across 15 cells × 2 variables at lag 3. Lags 1 and 5 each use their own 30-test diagnostic correction.
method.coverage: A year requires 12 usable months. The inherited fit requires at least 20 consecutive annual values. Failed fits enter Holm as p=1 and receive no verdict.
method.scope: Exploratory results for one product and fixed window. Slope intervals are marginal. Separate cell tests do not test a difference between cells.

reference_method.title: Time-Series Analysis of Remotely-Sensed SeaWiFS Chlorophyll in River-Influenced Coastal Regions
reference_method.authors: Acker, McMahon, Shen, Hearty and Casey (2009)
reference_method.application: Calendar-month departures averaged by year, followed by ordinary and robust slope comparisons.
reference_method.adaptation: Applied to POWER temperature and rainfall. Huber regression with tuning 1.345 is our robustness diagnostic; the paper uses MATLAB robust regression. Primary OLS/HAC/Holm inference is retained.
reference_method.paper_sections: Methods and Figure 15; Statistical Methods, Table 6 and Figure 16

seasonal_check.aggregation: Mean of 12 calendar-month departures, multiplied by 12 for annual precipitation.
seasonal_check.interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity on one NASA product. Diagnostic regression weights are statistical influence measures. The primary significance verdict uses the original annual OLS/HAC/Holm test.

event.interpretation: Fixed threshold, one radar pair. The recount verifies run arithmetic. Candidate overlap with mapped assets does not establish damage or closure. Independent event accuracy remains unestablished.

inference_boundary: The NASA model record ends in 2025. The saved 2026 satellite pair supports candidate observations at local scale. Event attribution requires separate evidence.
